name: TOTP Administrative Reset Endpoint
summary: Maps an authenticated operator's target-user TOTP reset request to the privileged administrative reset service while preserving actor and active-organization context.
requestContract: targetUserId route parameter + confirmed actor/org context

sourceReferences.note: ConfirmedUser-protected endpoint delegates targetUserId together with OrgEntityHeader and UserEntityHeader to ITotpAdministrativeResetService.
